robot_description2: Supervisor of dam construction, Concrete Man worked dutifully for years maintaining hydroelectric dams across the globe, but when a string of recession layoffs hit, ol' Concrete Man was on the chopping list, and he became what no robot can be - purposeless. Following the procedure of the laws of the World Robot Alliance, Concrete Man was scheduled to be decommissioned and scrapped. It was then that, falling into Dr. Wily's goading, that he and his Light-series siblings revolted against their fates and humanity. Concrete Man's incredible strength made him into an extreme threat, with blistering speed and fortitude to match! His Concrete Shot weapon, used once for construction, now allowed him to make a mess and trap his unfortunate foes! Concrete Man's stubborn, but likewise he's dedicated, and a motivated leader - as far as foremans go, he's world-class. He's good enough to even be able to tear Guts Man away from the karaoke bars. After the whole ordeal though, Concrete Man was able to pick up part-time work doing security for the city; he was great at keeping away puny, cranky, mad scientists!
